verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents its own double-entry accounting with a chart of accounts and journal entries, and it says it can prepare 'detailed financial reports' and generate tax-time reports. That is real reporting capability. However, no evidence names a P&L, balance sheet, or cash-flow statement, and none shows selecting arbitrary periods. The listed API report types (Invoice Details, Manual Journal Entry, Payments Collected) are not the three core statements. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements, custom/any-period date selection, on-demand generation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: preparing detailed financial reports, and making informed business decisions alongside your accountant
Your accountant will be able to update your journal entries and chart of accounts, giving you the most accurate view of your financial health. From there, they can run reports
Reports in FreshBooks provide detailed data on various aspects of your business. There are seven types of reports you are able to access
